The Dental Day Spa

The appointment itself, treated as part of the experience — calm rooms, unhurried time, and a CBD location you can reach on a lunch break or after work.

A calmer way to do dentistry

The Dental Day Spa is Art De Dente's own format: the same clinical treatments — veneers, whitening, crowns, implants — delivered as a considered appointment rather than a rushed one.

  • Cosmetic, restorative and implant dentistry
  • Level 17 CBD rooms on Queen St
  • Open seven days, including Sunday
  • Preferred provider for Medibank, Bupa and HCF

Landing pages for the treatments professionals ask about

Veneers, implants and CEREC crowns each get a dedicated page, so a search for one treatment lands on that treatment — not a generic appointment form.

Veneers

Porcelain veneers for shape, shade and alignment concerns, planned with the Dental Day Spa approach and the practice's cosmetic range — whitening and CEREC alongside.

Book a veneer consultation →

Implants

Implant treatment including sinus lift and bone grafting where needed, for single teeth and larger cases. Assessment first, then a plan built around your mouth, not a template.

Book an implant consultation →

CEREC crowns & bridges

CEREC technology for crowns and bridges, alongside dentures and full restorative care — for patients who want strong, natural-looking repair work without weeks of back-and-forth.

Book a crown consultation →

How booking works

01

Enquire

Use the form below or call 03 9125 6201. Say which treatment you are considering and whether you hold Medibank, Bupa or HCF cover.

02

Book

Choose a time that fits your working day — the practice is open seven days, with Saturday 9am–1pm and Sunday 7:30am–6pm.

03

Plan, then treat

Assessment and a treatment plan first. No prices are published, so costs are discussed at the appointment with your actual plan in front of you.
